screen.waiting_hint: Waiting for the toothbrush in Home Assistant
screen.head: Brush head
screen.choose_hint: Choose your toothbrush in the tile's options

app.name: Toothbrush
app.summary: Your electric toothbrush live: the zones you brush as a ring, the time, battery and pressure.
app.opt_brush_hint: The brush's main entity: Oral-B's toothbrush state, Sonicare's handle state, Laifen's status, Xiaomi's toothbrush.
app.opt_sector_hint: Its sector (Oral-B, Sonicare). Empty: the zones go by time.
app.opt_time_hint: Seconds brushed (Oral-B time, Sonicare brushing time, Laifen timer). Empty: the screen counts.
app.opt_pressure_hint: Oral-B pressure, Sonicare pressure state, Laifen pressing too hard.
app.opt_head_hint: Oral-B refill days, Sonicare brush head wear (on its brush head device), Xiaomi consumable.
app.opt_last_hint: Its last session (a moment), or Xiaomi's score.
app.opt_head_unit_hint: What the brush head entity counts.
app.opt_zones_hint: Auto shows 4 until the brush reports a fifth zone. Choose 6 for a brush that brushes in six from the start.
app.opt_routine_hint: How long a full session takes. It times the zones of a brush without a zone sensor.
app.opt_hold_hint: How many hours the ring shows how the last session went. 0 keeps it until the next one.
